question: Can the corrected deterministic selector produce exactly 50 structural-event-preserving, tunnel-balanced anchors with at least 5 m global Euclidean spacing on every fixed topology?
method: Read the sealed P01-P04 graph/spline files by frozen hash and construct only P05 graph/splines once from topology seed 503. Preserve terminal, junction-center/offset and strongest-turn event neighborhoods; interpolate candidates every 0.5 m of spline arc length; visit tunnels in deterministic round-robin order and accept the earliest globally 5 m-spaced candidate until exactly 50 anchors are reached. Execute the selector twice per parent and audit exact count, global pairwise spacing, structural-event coverage, every-tunnel coverage and selected-count spread no greater than 3. Save all 250 anchors, five complete X-Y/X-Z maps and aggregate metrics. Generate no mesh, rays, labels, formal data or models.
baseline: The sealed v2b event-first farthest-point fill stopped at 38/50 anchors on P04. It formed a maximal packing but did not control requested cardinality or branch balance.

user_authorization.scope: One immutable zero-mesh/zero-ray execution using four sealed graph/spline parents and one graph-only P05 construction; exactly 250 audit anchors, no sensor data or training.
user_authorization.confirmation_reference: 用户在获知完整主线以及当前先修复结构采样、再做零射线五图审计的范围后回复：做吧

acceptance_criteria: All frozen tool/source hashes and the pinned E1 Cano import identity match before RUNNING.
P01-P04 graph/splines are read only; P05 is constructed exactly once as graph/splines only; new mesh and ray counts remain zero.
Every parent has exactly 50 anchors and the global minimum pairwise Euclidean distance is at least 5 m.
Every structural event candidate is within 5 m of a selected anchor, every tunnel has anchors and selected-per-tunnel spread is at most 3.
A second selector call on each unchanged parent produces the identical canonical anchor hash.
Five complete maps and one aggregate figure show all 250 anchors with machine-readable provenance and no selected best cases.
Formal dataset, sensor observation, ray, training, model, trajectory, topology-runtime and M-TARE counts remain zero.
The immutable run completes within 300 seconds and 100 MiB with summary, raw log, RUN_STATE and evidence hashes.
stop_conditions: Any approval, source, environment, hash, scope or output-state mismatch
Any topology-family, exact-count, spacing, event-coverage, tunnel-coverage, balance, replay, visualization, time or disk failure
Continuation would require lowering count/spacing, changing seed/template, generating mesh/rays, retrying or selecting a replacement parent
expected_evidence: Frozen source/tool/environment identities, command, log, duration, exit code, RUN_STATE and evidence hashes
Five anchor JSONs, five per-parent metric JSONs, one P05 graph/spline pair and one input manifest
Five complete X-Y/X-Z anchor maps, one aggregate spacing/balance figure and provenance

estimated_cost.compute: One frozen-E1 CPU process; four read-only graph/spline parents and one graph-only P05 construction; no mesh, raycasting, GPU, simulator or training.
